items.title: Seagate Sinks 8%, Western Digital Down 6% on Election, Memory Price Worries
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSeagate shares fell 8% today as investors sold data center and storage stocks after the midterm elections, with Western Digital down too. Seagate has little exposure to flash memory prices, and most of its drive supply is allocated under contracts through 2028, so the drop looks overdone.
